findingDetails.title: Non-files cover fields open javascript and data scheme targets via window.open
findingDetails.evidence: parseCoverImage treats any URI scheme as external; isCoverImageBlocked is files-only; cover click window.open(image.target). Tests expect javascript:alert(1).png to parse as external and not be blocked for text columns.
findingDetails.recommendation: Allowlist http(s) on cover parse and click; reject javascript/data/file schemes the same way normalizeExplicitLinkTarget does.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Re-read cover-image.ts:56-72 and :107-108, tests 128-160, board-renderer.ts:969-971, gallery-renderer.ts:625-719.

results.summary: Gallery shares the hole; no new P0 class.
